rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and ZIP and used read-only tools to inspect orders. However, it performed order-changing actions (initiated returns and a cancellation) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating policy. Critically, it canceled the entire pending order #W2575533 instead of only the hose, despite the user’s instruction to cancel only the hose and, if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible, to not cancel anything else. This is a wrongful action. The refund total reported matches the tool outputs given the agent’s actions, but the actions themselves were noncompliant, so the request was not completed in line with policy.
